items.title: Tom Stagg Interview, 1969-10-03
items.q: they played King Oliver numbers, and ODJB numbers

ctx.x: Tom Stagg of London, England, 3rd October 1969. Talking about jazz in England from the earliest recollection, I have is about 1949, at that time there were probably only two or three jazz bands, mainly based on the early dance bands of the period. The dance bands of that period were Billy Cotton and Harry Roy. The Savoy Havana Band and the Savoy Ophians, which played at the Savoy Hotel in London for a long period for many years, from the late 1920s, the British jazz bands originated from this type of music,…
May I interrupt? Would you come from... come from, uh... the, uh... perhaps... 1949, the, uh, Ken Collier, the Queen River? You come from there. Yeah.
